featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area

today.name: CONVOY DECEPTICONS  ROBO DE CAMIONES A LOS AUTOBOTS
today.description:
TEMATICA DE TRANSPORTE DE CAMIONES 


El cielo sobre las carreteras del Pacífico Noroeste amenazaba tormenta cuando el convoy clandestino cruzó la frontera estatal de Montana. Tres imponentes camiones con especificaciones de los Autobots avanzaban en perfecta formación, pero sus sistemas de navegación habituales habían sido completamente hackeados. En las pantallas de sus cabinas parpadeaba un frío emblema morado.
	Los Decepticons habían ejecutado una emboscada perfecta en los talleres mecánicos de Sandpoint, Montana, apoderándose de valiosa tecnología de transporte enemiga. Ahora, la misión consistía en llevar el botín hasta su base secreta de operaciones en Sidney, Montana, antes de que la resistencia local o las patrullas fronterizas detectaran la anomalía.
A la vanguardia del grupo, guiando la ruta a través de los desolados paisajes montañosos de la Interestatal 90 y las rutas secundarias hacia el este, un imponente camión escolta lideraba la marcha. A través de la frecuencia encriptada de Truckers MP, el comandante a cargo emitió una orden directa a las unidades de soporte:
—Mantengan la formación en US Simulation y desactiven los rastreadores GPS de las cargas. Nos dirigimos directo a los sectores del este. Si algún rezagado interfiere en el camino a Sidney, aplástenlo.
Los motores diésel rugieron al unísono, devorando kilómetros de asfalto en la penumbra. Con los mapas de navegación fijados firmemente en las coordenadas finales de Sidney, el convoy avanzaba implacable. Cada cambio de marcha acercaba a los Decepticons a consolidar su dominio logístico en el sector, dejando atrás a unos Autobots totalmente desprovistos de sus mejores transportes.

## OCTOBERFEST BEER LTR FREE RIDE!
- Volná jízda ke příležitosti pivního festivalu Octoberfest!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/37Cc36F.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited for Non-alcoholic Beer, Beefs and Sausages.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)

*  **20:00** -  Passage around the city of Berlin.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZWjVLqN.png)

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*

We are back again for another year of Cancer Awareness! [Charity Discord Server](https://discord.gg/uyAPcu9kUm)



I know cancer can be really tough to fight and it's close to people's family so I went on and decided why not do my own cancer event to raise money for cancer

This is really close to me so I would like to see as many people as we can get there and show some support!

what is cancer?

Cancer is a group of diseases involving abnormal cell growth with the potential to invade or spread to other parts of the body. These contrast with benign tumors, which do not spread With more cancer research funding, Congress can help save more lives. Every major cancer breakthrough in the past 50 years can be traced back to federally funded research. More funding for cancer research means new lifesaving treatments, new ways to prevent the disease, and more lives saved.

Cancer Awareness Campaigns get people talking about cancer, reduces the stigma of the disease, and increases support for those suffering from cancer. Putting a face to cancer can help people understand the reality of a cancer diagnosis and bring home the importance of prevention in reducing each person’s overall risk.

Together we can beat cancer.
